name: Kumiyama (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Kumiyama town emblem in white: a ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised bud.
history: Municipal flag of Kumiyama, a town in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1969.

features.role: Kumiyama town emblem — a ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised bud
